speaker: (the watchman)
text: You, with the pack. Hold on the bridge.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am held. Bread and cheese, a shirt, and paper in a cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Bread. Jacqueline's cheese. The paper is in oilcloth. There is nothing else in the mouth of it.

speaker: (the bridge alewife)
text: A quart is a penny. Bread is extra, if you are buying bread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One penny for the quart. I am not buying bread. The cheese is from a friend's house. It was already in the pack.

speaker: (the bridge alewife)
text: Then pay the penny, and be off my bench when the quart is done.
